title: A lake that is usually dry
text: Koehn Lake in the Fremont Valley is a dry lake that is closed to outflow in some seasons. Any water that collects there leaves by evaporation. The dry lakebed is about 5 miles long and 3 miles across at its widest. The Garlock Fault steps sideways across a gap about 3 kilometers wide near the lake.
